hook: What if AI agents never re-read context?

beats.say: Ramp Labs introduced speculative encoding, a single 2.35 billion parameter mixture of experts model that translates between different models' hidden states.
One model reads a long document once, and the translator hands its understanding to other models, so multi-agent swarms skip reading the same context again.
Across seven models it keeps 96.9 percent of base accuracy and cuts prefill latency by up to seven and a half times on long documents.
